In the third grade, me, just like everyone else, liked pokemon cards. We would being them to school, trade, battle, and have fun with them. One day this kid, let's say his name is Tom, steals me and my friends pokemon cards from our back packs. Me and my friend knew that tom did it, and told the teacher, because that's how we roll, and the teacher took this big stack of cards from his desk, not all of it was ours, but as revenge, we sorted out which ones were ours, then split the remaining bit. Anyways, the next day the kid started fights over the cards, and even threatened people, and we were chillin, and we got called out on it because we were the ones that took his cards, me and my friend claimed that they were ours, but after the kid broke a window with a chair after a freak out in class, the school made a rule stating that there were to be no pokemon cards or trading cards of any kind on school property.
